method.filtering_summary: Live search at about 7:30 AM EAT on 16 sources pulled 2,612 postings (ReliefWeb failed again, and Wellfound's automated fetch is switched off on purpose, so it is checked in Ben's signed-in browser separately). 1679 were older than 7 days and 53 were old reposts, 242 senior or excluded titles, 212 not target roles, 189 excluded Kenya, 22 already applied and 74 duplicates, leaving 141. Roles already shown in earlier briefings were skipped, along with new copies of G2i's talent-pool listings. Jobgether answered live (508 offers, 230 from the last 7 days, 30 kept by the script), but every new engineering offer was tied to one European country, so none made the list. micro1 answered live (62 pulled, 14 kept by the script); the new roles are mostly specialist engineering-expert work (SysML, electronics, CAD, aerospace), and the AI Agent Evaluator role is the one that fits. Jobicy answered but every date looked like a bump date.

stories.title: Grok Bot can now make phone calls
stories.summary: The official Grok Bot account said on Nov 4 that the bot can place calls for users: it shows a call card to approve, runs a live transcript, and lets the user take over or end the call. Coverage says it is limited to US numbers for now.
stories.why: Agents that act over voice, with an approval step and a live transcript, are exactly the agent-plus-human-in-the-loop pattern he builds and can point to in interviews.

stories.title: Musk tightens Grok Bot usage limits, citing serving costs
stories.summary: Elon Musk said the cost of serving Grok Bot was "unsustainably high relative to revenue" as subscribers reported weekly allowances running out early.
stories.why: Inference cost is now the constraint for agent products, so engineers who can make agents cheaper to run are in demand.

stories.title: Anthropic prepares IPO as compute costs weigh
stories.summary: TechCabal reports Anthropic is preparing an IPO, possibly as soon as Nov 16, after earning $17 billion in Q3 2026 revenue while spending about $10 billion on compute.
stories.why: The biggest AI IPO so far will shape funding and hiring across AI startups, including the ones he applies to.

stories.title: Fal raises $1.3B at a $16B valuation
stories.summary: AI inference startup Fal raised a $1.3 billion Series F led by Bessemer, with Nvidia participating, doubling its valuation from $8 billion in April.
stories.why: Inference platforms are where much of the AI money is going, and hosted model APIs like Fal's are tools he can use in agent builds.

stories.title: Traversal raises $120M for AI agents that fix outages
stories.summary: New York-based Traversal raised a $120 million Series B led by Kleiner Perkins, Redpoint and Khosla, bringing total funding to $173 million.
stories.why: Agents for site reliability are a growing niche, and the company says it will hire in research and engineering.

stories.title: Lazarus AI and Guava raise for self-hosted and voice AI
stories.summary: Boston-based Lazarus AI raised $43 million for AI systems organisations run under their own control, and Guava raised $12.5 million for enterprise voice AI.
stories.why: Self-hosted AI and voice agents both match his quantised-LLM and agent experience.

stories.title: Canva cuts 1,271 roles, about 22% of staff
stories.summary: Canva is cutting or changing 22% of its workforce as growth slows and AI costs rise, merging product, growth and platform teams and moving hybrid staff back to the office part of the week.
stories.why: Even strong product companies are trimming and asking people to cover more ground, which favours generalist full-stack and AI engineers.

stories.title: Fiserv has cut 3,000 jobs; US openings rise to 7.52 million
stories.summary: Fiserv said it has cut 3,000 jobs since June, while US job openings rose to 7.52 million in September, though hiring is at its slowest pace since 2013.
stories.why: Payments giants are cutting while overall hiring stays slow, so fewer seats open up for new graduates, which makes targeted applications matter more.

stories.title: Nedbank completes takeover of 66% of NCBA
stories.summary: South Africa's Nedbank completed its purchase of a 66% stake in NCBA, Kenya's fifth-largest bank, pushing NSE trading to KES 107.7 billion in a day.
stories.why: A new owner often brings technology and digital-banking changes, so NCBA may be one to watch for fintech engineering roles.

stories.title: Safaricom says M-PESA created KES 478bn in social value
stories.summary: Safaricom's sustainability report says M-PESA generated about KES 478.1 billion in social value in FY26 and that 57.8% of M-PESA transactions carried no customer charge.
stories.why: M-PESA remains the backbone of Kenyan fintech integrations, which is the kind of work he did on loans and payments.
